balls.text: full and wide outside off. Cummins walks down the ground and towards the off side but fails to connect. Unadkat is charging down the other end but Cummins is unmoved. Samson collects it and lobs it to Avesh who nails the direct hit to find Unadkat short. SRH have reviewed it for a wide but to no avail
full and wide. Unadkat cuts it towards sweeper cover for one
full and way outside off. Unadkat moves across and helps it over short fine leg for a four

a low full toss around off. Shahbaz goes low and pulls it towards long-on. Not much power behind it, though. Jurel runs in diagonally to his left, pouches it with both hands before diving forward to complete the catch
a short ball outside off but this time it's too high. Shahbaz lets it go through
slower short ball. Beats Shahbaz on the pull
nails the wide yorker. Shahbaz fails to get any bat on it
another slower short ball. Cummins was confused what to do with it. In the end he tried ramping it over but missed
a length ball wide outside off. Shahbaz moves across and drags it towards long-on
a length ball on the stumps. Turned towards midwicket but only a single
a slower short ball. Cummins was looking to dab it behind point but gets beaten by the lack of pace
another yorker, on off stump this time. Cummins gets his bat down just in time and opens the face as well to steer it just past the diving Samson

Yorked him! Only 121.1kph and that might have played a role in Klaasen missing it; he seemed a touch early into the shot. Missed it completely and the ball crashed into middle and leg. Before this ball, our Forecaster was predicting 187 for SRH; now it's down to 182
full around off. Shahbaz pushes it to the right of the bowler who stops it in his follow-through
another slower bouncer but way down the leg side
full on the pads. Flicked towards deep midwicket to bring up his fifty, off 33 balls
a slower bouncer around off. Shahbaz dabs it down towards short third
a yorker on the leg stump. Shahbaz backs away and works it towards midwicket for a couple
a slower length ball angling across. Klaasen flat-bats it towards long-off
a wide yorker but it's too wide. Need to bowl that again
full around off and Klaasen smashes it into the sightscreen
a misfield. Was a length ball outside off that Shahbaz steered to the right of backward point who dived across but let it through. Kohler-Cadmore was the fielder
length ball on the stumps. Worked straight towards deep midwicket this time, so will get only a single
length ball on the pads. And Klaasen does a replay of the previous ball. Places it in front of square leg for two more
length ball on the pads. Flicked in front of square leg for a couple
full on the stumps. Pushed towards long-on
just a touch shorter and that's enough for Shahbaz to rock back and pull it over deep midwicket. That is the shorter side as well
short of length around off. Punched towards extra cover who is at the edge of the circle
a slower bouncer. Beats Shahbaz on the pull
full around off. Driven towards long-off
a length ball. Drags the pull towards square leg but only a single
length ball around off. Shahbaz finds short midwicket with the pull
length ball at the stumps. Tucked away towards short midwicket
a bouncer. Shahbaz attempt a pull and gets beaten. SRH want to review the non-wide call. And yes, that was too high
length ball on the stumps. Defended back
a full toss on the stumps. Shahbaz was looking to nudge it towards midwicket but the ball hits the outer half of the ball and rolls towards covers
length ball but way outside off. Shahbaz gets beaten on the cut but will get a wide
full outside off. Steered towards point. No run this time as the fielder attacks the ball
a length ball on the stumps. Nudged towards midwicket for a couple as the fielder is deep
a low full toss on the leg stump. Chipped towards long-on; one bounce to the fielder
the Klaasen pull! Goes back to a length ball and forces it over long-on for a big six. That went 89 metres
full and down the leg side. Called a wide

a first-ball duck! A length ball around off that was angling in and perhaps just straightened after pitching to make a mess of the stumps. Samad planted his front foot across and looked to work it on the leg side only to missed it altogether

the ploy of having two short thirds works. Full and wide outside off from Avesh, Reddy went for the reverse hit. He connected alright but ended up hitting it straight to Chahal, the wider short third. He takes it reverse cups, just above the shoulder height to his left
full length outside off. Klaasen looks to smash it through the off side but gets an inside edge that rolls towards the leg side
a wide yorker. Reddy opens the face to steer it behind point
full and wide outside off. Reddy goes for the reverse hit but misses. Not called a wide and SRH have reviewed it. The TV umpire says since Reddy moved towards the off side, it's not a wide
a low full toss outside off. Reddy mistimes it towards sweeper cover
flatter, fuller and faster. Reddy gets down on his knee and hits it towards sweeper cover for one
backs away and Chahal follows him this time. Almost a yorker. Klaasen digs it out towards deep midwicket
Klaasen shows his class. He goes back to a length ball around off and lofts it over extra cover, all the way for a six. Ends the string of dots with a six
flatter and quicker on the stumps. Pushed towards extra cover. Three dots
backs away early this time and Chahal sees that. Fires this one full and well outside off. Klaasen can only watch it go into Samson's gloves
length ball on the pads. Klaasen misses the flick and gets hit on the pads
a slower bouncer. Reddy was early into the pull and gets beaten
an excellent yorker but Klaasen manages to take it on the full and flick it towards deep midwicket
length outside off. Klaasen hits it straight towards extra cover
a slower bouncer. Too high and Klaasen lets it go through
length ball outside off, a bit of extra bounce. Reddy goes back and cuts it towards deep point. Powell sprints to his left to keep it to one
a length ball into the pitch. Klaasen chops it towards long-off
length outside off. Cuts it through point but Powell from sweeper cover moves to keep his left to keep it to two
pushed towards extra cover off the back foot
a googly, which Reddy failed to spot. Came forward and pushed at it, only for the ball to hold its line and hit the inside edge before deflecting onto the pads
a leading edge but falls well short of a diving Jaiswal at extra over. Was full on the stumps and Reddy was looking to flick it towards midwicket
flatter on the stumps once again - 96.7kph. Flicked towards deep midwicket
length ball at the stumps, 91.6kph. Klaasen goes back and flicks it to the left of deep midwicket
length ball on the pads. Flicked towards short fine leg

the slower bouncer has done the trick once again. Sandeep banged it in, straight at the batter. Head gave himself a bit of room and looked to steer it over but ended up guiding it into the lap of short third
a slower short ball. Head goes for the pull. But he was already through it before the ball reached him
another slower one. Klaasen cuts it towards long-off this time
109.2kph. A slower one outside off. Klaasen mistimes the cut into the ground and is unhappy with himself
length outside off. Cuts it towards deep extra cover. Boult patrolling there
a length ball on the stumps. Punched towards long-off
another carrom ball, this time on middle and leg. Tucked away behind square by Klaasen
a full toss around off. Belted along the ground and straight towards long-off
a carrom ball at the stumps. Punched towards long-off
length ball around off. Cuts it towards sweeper cover
goes for the slog sweep to a straight ball and gets beaten. The bounce from the pitch means it goes over the stumps. An appeal for caught behind by Samson but not given
attacks the stumps with a quicker one. Pushed to the right of Ashwin who makes a diving stop
full on thee stumps. Flicked towards deep midwicket
a length ball well outside off. Cuts it towards sweeper cover
trademark Klaasen quasi-pull. A length ball around off. Klaasen goes back and lofts it over deep midwicket - 81 metres
length ball on off stump. Punched towards long-off
length ball at the stumps. 94.3kph. Klaasen goes back and punches it towards long-off
full outside off. Driven towards long-off
a low full toss outside off. Steered straight towards Sandeep this time
full and wide and Head throws his bat at it. Sandeep at deep third moves to his left but gets awkward bounce and lets it go for four
short of length at the stumps. Head goes back and across and flicks it over square leg - that's the shorter side as well, which means it goes all the way for a six
length ball on the pads. Head was looking to flick it over short fine leg but doesn't really middle it and the ball dribbles to the fielder
length ball around off. Klaasen opens the face of the bat to steer it through covers
a length ball angling across. Head cuts it towards sweeper cover
length ball on the stumps. Pushed towards long-on
length ball angling towards the batter. Head cuts it into the ground and it bounces through the gap between cover and point. That's the shorter boundary as well
length outside off. Finds the point fielder with the cut
Too full around off and it appeared Head was just waiting for it. Clears his front leg and hits it over mid-off for his first boundary of the night
length ball on the pads. Flicked in front of square leg
length ball on the pads. Head misses the flick but collects a leg bye to fine leg

Markram lasts just two balls on his return. A length ball angling across. He throws his bat at it and gets an outside edge. Chahal at short third goes low on his knees and takes it comfortably. The move to give Boult a third over inside the powerplay fetches RR two wickets
length ball jagging back in to hit the inside edge and the thigh. Head picks up a single off the deflection
length ball at the stumps. Flicked in front of square leg to get off the mark

the slower bouncer does the trick. Tripathi was looking to ramp it over - it's a shot he plays well - but the lack of pace means he ends up guiding it to Chahal at short third. Tripathi is disappointed with himself. RR will be happy that the dropped catch didn't cost much
Boult tries to correct his line and length but ends up bowling it short outside off. Tripathi pounces on it and cuts it behind point
supla shot! A length ball at the stumps and Tripathi brings his wrists into play to help it over fine leg for a six

a carrom ball to beat the outside edge as Tripathi was looking to force it through the off side. Or was there an edge? Ashwin isn't happy with Samson who failed to collect it cleanly. Seeing an opportunity, Head scampers to the other end for a single
length ball on the stumps. Pushed back towards the bowler
a rare full toss from Ashwin and Tripathi doesn't miss out. Sweeps it over backward square leg
Chahal will not be able to stop it this time. Was a flatter and quicker delivery from Ashwin. Tripathi stayed still and opened the face of the bat at the last moment to place it fine of short third
full around off. Tripathi shuffles a bit and hits it over mid-off for four
length ball at the stumps. Pushed towards mid-on off the back foot
finds the gap this time. A length ball outside off and Tripathi sends it between cover and point
length outside off. Sliced to the left of the point fielder where Jurel makes a diving stop
full around off. Pushed towards mid-off for one

short of length at the body. Tripathi goes for the pull but isn't in control of it as the ball hurries onto him. It lands just short of Sandeep Sharma at short fine, who has a shy at the non-striker's end. Had he hit, Tripathi would have been run-out
a yorker on the stumps, swings back a touch as well. Tripathi does well to get his bat down in time
length ball at the stumps. Pushed to the left of the point fielder
full on the stumps. Tripathi moves across and sweeps it over short fine leg. One-bounce four
length ball on the off stump. Head goes back and cuts it to the left of point where the fielder makes a partial stop
pushed wide of mid-off for a single

extra bounce! A length ball outside off, Tripathi goes for the cut but fails to keep it down. Luckily for him it went between point and short third. Chahal puts in the chase and flicks it back with a slide
full outside off. Driven towards long-off
length ball on the stumps. Tucked away towards square leg
Boult strikes in the first over once again! It was a length ball and Abhishek went for the pull, only for the ball to hit high on the bat and lob towards covers where Kohler-Cadmore makes no mistake
length outside off. Cuts it behind point for a couple
too full, too straight and Abhishek drives it between the stumps and the non-striker for four more
a length ball around off and Abhishek gets off the mark in style. Pulls it over deep midwicket - that's the shorter boundary as well
full outside off and swinging away. Abhishek was down the track early but fails to connect as the ball moves away from him
short of length angling towards the pads. Head looks to tuck it away but gets an inside edge onto the thigh, and they sneak in a single

Hyderabad city reach their fourth IPL final and SRH make their third! Short ball around off stump and the shot is mistimed towards backward point. Jurel unbeaten on 56 but it is SRH who win. SRH win by 36 runs!
short ball on off and he top-edges a pull towards fine leg.
yorker length ball on middle, and drilled to long on
back of a length slower ball outside off. Tries to ramp it over short-third but very nearly gives a catching chance to backward point
full ball on off and Jurel impresses with a flick through wide long on for four! Consolation runs
yorker length ball on off stump and toe-ends the drive to long on

and that should be the game! Length ball on off and he toe-ends a flat-batted shot to mid on. They don't take a single and the camera pans to the SRH owners' box where they are congratulating each other. The Marans seem delighted!
Short ball angling in, and pulled to fine leg for a single. RR need 42 in 7.

slower ball bouncer just outside off. Jurel lets it go over his shoulder. Dot given but Royals review as they must if they want to stay alive in this game (barring extras). The TV umpire agrees with Jurel that it's a wide, so the decision is overturned. RR still alive, barely.
Cummins bowls a cutter back of a good length. Pulled to deep backward square leg and the single is turned down again
pulls Cummins to the deep-square leg fielder but turns down the single
good-length ball angling into Jurel and he picks the screws off his ball, pulling in front of square, and getting his fifty in 26 balls!
...but Jurel keeps RR's slim hopes alive. Short ball angling into Jurel and he thumps a pull behind square, beating the fielder at deep backward square leg
back of a length ball outside off. Boult swings across the line and misses
full ball on off and driven to mid off. No run chance

short ball on middle, and Powell pulls towards deep midwicket. However he takes his eyes off the ball and the timing is not great either. Abhishek runs to his left from deep midwicket and manages to keep standing while completing a running catch
short of good length around off stump. Angling across a bit. Powell attempts the pull but misses altogether. On the bounce to the keeper
full ball on middle and off. Hammered past Natarajan's right, but Cummins has kept a very straight long on to protect straight boundaries.

bang on the throat! Jurel is through the slower-ball bouncer too early, and therefore has to take a blow on his body. Jurel went down but then got up swiftly. Didn't expect him to stay down for too long, he comes from a family of brave people
short ball outside off. Sticking to the plan and Jurel struggles to generate much power. Pulled to midwicket for only one. RR need 53 in 18 balls
short ball around off but he rolls his fingers over this. Pulled again to deep square leg. Cummins has taken the pace off after that initial six to the longer end of this stadium
good length ball on off stump and pulled to deep midwicket for a single
slower ball bouncer on middle and leg. Jurel moves to the off side to pull but misses. Not a wide

Tripathi has been a livewire tonight! Jurel picks up this full ball on middle beautifully, lifting it over the leg side for what appeared to be six. But Tripathi at deep midwicket jumps on the line to parry the ball back, however even if it looked brilliant, the replay shows his foot touched the rope. The six will stand.
the SRH captain returns with a short ball on off. Powell takes his eyes off but pulls anyway. To deep square leg

drilled back past Abhishek four another four by Jurel! Full just outside off stump and Jurel ensures he hits the part-timer away while he can. Nonetheless, an excellent spell from Abhishek, finishing with 2-24.
full ball wider outside off. Bit of turn away. Slices a drive to point and Tripathi intercepts well. But the throw is wild, and it allows them to take an overthrow run.
full ball on middle. Closes the bat's face and flicks to deep midwicket
bad line, and punished by Jurel. Full and wide, allowing Jurel to pounce onto that well. Caresses a drive through the covers!
full ball around off and he pushes to cover, where Cummins takes a tumble while fielding
full toss, wide outside off. Drilled to deep extra cover for a single
Jurrreellll!! Full ball on middle. Jurel makes room and goes inside out, lifting Shahbaz over cover for four. Shahbaz finishes with 3-23 as the equation becomes 74 off 30.
Jurel reverse sweeps! Full ball lands outside the right-hander's leg stump but he changes his manner to play a shot over conventional point
finally gets a run away. Cuts this wide-ish ball to the deep for a single
length ball on off stump. Worked to the leg side off the back foot
full ball outside off. Hurriedly pushed to cover point and that's a second dot ball
good length ball on off. Bit of turn away. Pushed to cover
around the stumps to Powell. Full ball outside off. Bunted gently to backward point's left for a single. Another brilliant over from Abhishek. Time out
full ball outside off. Left alone first ball. To the keeper

Beautiful ball! Good length ball around off. Straightens after pitching, and turns away slightly instead of coming in. Hetmyer looks to play a back-foot punch but the ball's wizardry leaves him stunned. Off-stump pegged back and this magic ball has put RR six down
good length ball on middle, and he pulls in front of square for a single
yorker length ball on leg stump, and he toe-ends a gentle shot to midwicket. They take a quick one, and the second is on too, but Jurel turns down Hetmyer. Remember, Jurel was run-out last game
full toss outside leg. Hetmyer gets low for a slog sweep but he misses out on this golden opprtunity. Ball crashes into his pad outside leg stump

dancing shoes on! Jurel is a good player of spin and he isn't letting the game's situation change that. Comes down the track and hits this full ball on middle stump with the turn. Over deep midwicket for half a dozen.
full ball just outside off stump. Tries to play it straight back but an inside edge takes the ball to midwicket
length ball on off stump, and clipped to deep midwicket
length ball just outside off. Cut to deep point for a single
big turn away! Full ball outside off. And turning away with Hetmyer trying to smack it down the ground. He misses and then reviews for a wide. But it'll stay as a dot.
what happened there? The ball pops out of Markram's hand and very nearly lands near short fine leg! Ball slipped out? Anyway, a no-ball and a free-hit.
full ball on off stump and driven to short cover. Stopped!
full ball on middle, and knocked to midwicket for a single. Very nearly a double-wicket maiden over!
full ball on middle and off stump. Defended back to the bowler.

Third wicket for the impact player! Shahbaz bowls fullish again. Ashwin opts to go onto the back foot instead of driving. But unlike the last two balls, he does get bat on ball, however unfortunately for him it's the outside edge of the bat, and Klaasen grabs a tough chance!
Ashwin can't pick the spin at Chepauk! Full ball just outside off. Sharp turn away as Ashwin once again plays and misses while attempting a drive.
big turn away! Full ball outside off, tempting Ashwin to drive but he misses the shot altogether. Klaasen whips the bails off so the umpires want to check for the stumping.

now Shahbaz-Sharma combine! And is this the last of Riyan Parag for the season? Skiddy good, length ball on middle. Parag tries to mow a pull over cow corner or so, but he mistimes it altogether. Abhishek Sharma at deep midwicket gets under it.
faster, skiddier delivery. Good length just outside off and the hurried cut can't beat backward point
full ball just outside off stump. Defended towards cover point
length ball outside off and he cuts it behind square but the fielder at deep extra cover also runs around the boundary line to keep the runs to only two
Tripathi stops the four! Full ball outside leg and Jurel gets low for a well-hit sweep at deep backward square. But Tripathi runs along the boundary line and then puts his body on the line too
full ball on middle stump and he drives to long on for a single
worked towards deep midwicket
full ball just outside off. Parag offers good footwork to open up the space at extra cover, driving along the ground to pick up a couple. Only three off the over. Royals 73/3 in 10 overs
full ball on off stump. Parag gently dabs a fending shot towards backward point. Wants one but is sent back by the point fielding running in
full ball just outside off. Parag bunts it towards the off side but can't beat cover again
full ball just outside off. Bit of turn away and fended to the off side
full ball on middle stump. Gets forward and nudges it off his toes to the leg side
full ball on off. Big stride in and defended
length ball outside off has been cut behind square for a single. Only 4 runs off that over
full ball outside off. Bit of turn away. Guided to point's right for a single
good length ball around off. Cut to point, where a misfield allows them a single

the left-arm spinners are doing the job! The Royals captain falls for an 11-ball 10 and the SRH owner is also delighted in the stands. Length ball on middle, and Samson tries to make room before flat-batting a shot between long on and deep midwicket. However he hits it straighter than he likes, allowing Markram at long on to have a chance of a catch. He doesn't disappoint, sliding diagonally forward to get the RR captain.
gripping and turning. Full ball on middle. Bit of turn away. Fended towards point
peach of a ball. Full on middle. Grips and turns away. Parag tries to defend but it takes an outside edge to short third
full ball outside off. Inside out drive to wide long off

Shahbaz pulls his length back and Jaiswal has mistimed it to long off. Gives it some flight but doesn't pitch it full. Jaiswal comes down the track to hit the spinner for a big shot, but ends up slicing it. Impact from the Impact player as Jaiswal goes for a 21-ball 42.
full ball on off and he hits it square for one
full ball driven to long on for a single

Shahbaz snakes in front of the umpire and then delivers an around-the-stumps delivery on middle stump. Jaiswal picks the pocket at conventional third-man beautifully by bringing out the reverse sweep and hitting it over the boundary
full ball on middle. Sliding into leg. Tucked to midwicket for a single
full ball on middle stump and driven to long on. Another slower ball

around the stumps again. Short of good length ball on off stump, with pace taken off again.  Samson tries to pull, and the ball goes over his head, but it won't be a wide since it took a touch off his bat before going to the keeper on the bounce
length ball just outside off. Cutter too. Flicked to the leg side but mistimed
slower ball bouncer. Outside off stump. Jaiswal wants to swat it away over point but is deceived by the pace-off delivery. But the square-umpire calls it a wide for height
around the stumps to Samson. Starts off with a pace-on ball to him. Good length around off stump and Samson guides it to the third-man fielder on the boundary who is standing very fine
slower ball, full outside off. Driven to long on for a jogging single
starts off with a pace-on ball. Good length outside off and true bounce onto Jaiswal's chest-region. Fends with hard hands, sending the ball towards mid off
swipes across the line and hits this length ball to deep square leg. A 19-run over ends the powerplay

that's well placed! Bhuvneshwar bowls a short of good length ball on middle. Ball is also angling away, and Jaiswal opens the bat's face in such a way that his sliced cut goes past backward point's right
knuckle ball on middle and off. Jaiswal waits and waits and waits before smothering a drive just past the reach of the fielder at cover!

misfield, misunderstanding, but no run out. Bhuvneshwar bowls full outside leg stump. Jaiswal also makes room and then drives inside out to mid off's right. But the fielder stops it, however a fumble tempts Jaiswal to try a single
smacked straight back for four more. Full ball on his toes and Jaiswal clobbers it over Bhuvneshwar's left. Beats mid on too.

flat-batted over wide long on! Jaiswal exposes all three stumps while backing away. Bhuvneshwar bowls a short of good length ball outside leg, and that sets up Jaiswal well for the shot over the leg side

example of a tracer bullet right there! Fullish ball, but angling across from Samson. The true bounce allows Samson to sit back and cut it from a decent height, and the ball flies across, beating deep point who was present
slower ball bouncer gone wrong. No shot offered as the ball balloons over the RR captain's head
fullish ball on off. Opens the bat's face and guides the ball towards cover point. Can't beat the infielders
good length ball outside off and pushed towards cover point. No single this time
full ball on middle and off. Gently pushed past the non-striker and the timing is so sublime that the ball beats mid off too. Markram from mid on gives it a chase and does well to drag the ball back
good length ball around off and he punches a shot towards cover
good length ball on middle. Sliding further into Jaiswal, and he misses the flick due to the ball's movement. Hits him on the ab

High in the night sky, and Tripathi holds on! Kohler-Cadmore's time ends for a 16-ball 10. Fullish ball around off. Bit of wobble in the seam. Kohler-Cadmore backs away and tries to play a release shot over cover, but instead the ball goes high up more towards point. Tripathi tracks it over his head and then dives late near the circle to complete that catch.
short ball on middle and leg. Kohler-Cadmore backs away and tries to play another ramp over Klaasen, but on this occasion he cannot get bat on ball
gets the boundary awayby backing away and using Cummins' pace to play an uppercut towards deep third! Makes good use of Cummins' pace and bounce
good length ball on middle and leg. Angling into him. Opens the bat's face and guides a shot towards backward point
knee-high full toss around off. But Kohler-Cadmore drills the drive straight to the cover point fielder. This was the ball he could've used to break away, but alas for him, he couldn't
back of a length ball on leg stump. Jaiswal swats a pull away, but not very aggressively, and gets the ball to deep square leg

length ball on middle, with Bhuvneshwar keeping a very straight line to Kohler-Cadmore. Ball angles into the batter's body as he makes some room, and even though he swings the bat across the line, he miss the shot, and the ball thuds onto his body
good length ball around off and he opens the bat's face before slicing a shot towards point
pumped away! Length ball on leg and angling towards middle and off. Jaiswal keeps a still head and pulls in front of square, hitting it along the ground too
good length ball on middle and pushed to mid off after backing away. Calls for the single and gets across swiftly
length ball outside off. Far enough for him to cut it away but he misses out altogether

smart from Bhuvneshwar! Sees the batter moving leg side and follows him by bowling a short of good length ball outside leg that keeps the batter honest. He can't do much, and while trying to fend, ends up inside-edging it towards the keeper

just short of a diving midwicket! Length ball on off and comes onto his body at an awkward height while cramping him for room. Uncomfortably bunts a shot to the leg side and Abhishek was the fielder lurking

edged? Massive caught-behind appeal. But turned down. Full ball wide outside off and Kohler-Cadmore tried to squeeze a shot away past point. The sound was bat hitting the ground most probably. Cummins does not review
good length ball on off. Angling into middle. Tries to defend off the back foot, but does so with hard hands. Ball pops up at a catch height but it's just a few metres away from Cummins' left
mowed over midwicket and it's safe there. Shahbaz chases after the ball. Fullish ball angling in and the batter shoveled it over the leg side
good length ball just outside off stump, and he plays a punchy shot uncomfortably towards point
full ball on middle stump. Cummins falls over on the followthrough. Tom drills a drive to mid off, and Markram is swift across the ground to intercept that
five rows back! Good length ball on his hips, and he needs no second invitation. Uses his wrists to pick this up from his waist region, sending the ball over deep backward square leg
good length ball outside off. Cuts behind square after standing tall, sending the ball to deep third
short of good length ball outside off. Kohler-Cadmore  tries to cut but the ball is awfully close to his body. Nearly inside-edges that right onto his own stumps
length ball on leg stump. Swinging across towards off stump. Poked to point for a quick single for the first runs of the innings
good length ball outside off stump. Punchy shot, aggressive, but to cover
good length ball angling across from Bhuvneshwar, and nudged towards backward point
